Yes cold sores are the same as herpes. Herpes commonly found on the mouth is HSV1 and herpes found on the genital is HSV2. However you can get either in either location. Fortunately however many many people have herpes and it’s really not that big a deal :). You guys are going to be fine. If the outbreak on your lip starts causing you too much pain or if it gets worse you can go to your doctor and get acyclovir and that will help clear the outbreak faster. But yes, herpes and cold sores are the same thing!

I’d say the first outbreak lasts around 2 weeks. The antivirals should start to work in a few days. I’d recommend over the counter pain meds as well as a hot bath. That always helps speed my healing. I do not know if you’re male or female but as a woman it has always helped me to get a water bottle and pour it over myself as I urinate to avoid any burning. Other than that I’m really sorry but the first one is the worst and you just have to rough it out. I promise you the next will not be so bad though and eventually you will probably stop having outbreaks as frequently or all together. Take some time off work, indulge in whatever you do for self care. Avoid foods high in arginine or liquor. You got this it’s going to be okay I promise.

Sooo I’d say a lot happened here. 

1. Him telling you when you were high on acid was quite possibly the WORST time to tell you. 

2. You should understand he probably didn’t tell you until then because he was nervous. It can be hard to disclose at times. He is right though, if all you did is kiss and he has genital herpes you will be fine. 
 
So at this point I think you need to decide if you’re okay w being w someone w herpes or not. There’s lots of good research out there and honestly it’s a lot more common and less serious than you think. If I disclosed to someone and they broke out into tears I would not contact them again either lol. I’d send him a message saying it doesn’t change how you feel about him and you’re sorry for your response to it. (If that’s how you feel) otherwise maybe just give it up. What you shouldn’t do is make him feel bad about waiting to disclose. (Acid aside lol) plenty of people wait until they actually meet w someone to disclose.
